```{r}

library(here)
```

```{r}

```

```{r}
skimr::skim(data)
```

Which zone is NA?

```{r}
data %>%
  filter(is.na(zone))
```

```{r}
data <- data %>%
  filter(!is.na(zone))
```

```{r}
skimr::skim(data)
```

do we need the time shucked value?  probably not...

```{r}
data <- data %>%
  select(-time_shucked)
```

Why are so many NA for sex?

```{r}
data %>%
  count(sex)
```

I think there is an issue here -- if there is a sperm rating above 0, then they must be male

```{r}
data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = sperm_rating)) + 
  geom_histogram()
```

```{r}
data %>%
  filter(sperm_rating == 0) %>%
  count(sex)
```

There is a mistake in a couple had their sperm rating put in the "egg count" column

```{r}
data <- data %>%
  mutate(sperm_rating = if_else(tube_id == 	"FEB_SDJ_9", egg_count, sperm_rating)) %>%
  mutate(sperm_rating = if_else(tube_id == 	"FEB_SDJ_11", egg_count, sperm_rating)) %>%
  mutate(egg_count = if_else(tube_id == "FEB_SDJ_9", NA, egg_count)) %>% 
  mutate(egg_count = if_else(tube_id == "FEB_SDJ_11", NA, egg_count))
```

```{r}
test <- data %>%
  mutate(sex = case_when(
    !is.na(sperm_rating) & sperm_rating == 0 ~ "U",
    !is.na(sperm_rating) & sperm_rating >= 1 ~ "M", 
    is.na(sex) ~ "U",
    sex == "F" ~ "F",
    sex == "H" ~ "H",
    TRUE ~ NA
  ))
```

```{r}
test %>%
  count(sex, sperm_rating)
```

```{r}
test %>% 
  filter(sex == "U") %>%
  count(egg_count)
```

Ok, looks like we did this right.

```{r}
data <- test
```

```{r}
skimr::skim(data)
```

Ugh, time to go through the notes

remove the ROCK

```{r}
data <- data %>%

```

```{r}
data %>%
  count(notes) %>% 
  print(n = Inf)
```


Ok, what is the ramification of DEAD

- keep in mind that meat weight is calculated by subtracting shell_weight_and_meat_weight from shell_weight 

Ok, I guess if dead, we need to make total_weight, shell_weight_and_meat_weight, and meat_weight NA, because a dead oyster would be leaking its liquor which could throw off calculations you may want to use with total weight, and it's not useful to know the weight of a dead oyster

```{r}
examine<-data %>%
  filter(notes %in% c("DEAD", "Dead when shucked", "dead"))

test<-data %>%
  mutate(total_weight = case_when(
    notes %in% c("DEAD", "Dead when shucked", "dead") ~ NA, 
    TRUE ~ total_weight
  )) %>%
  mutate(shell_weight_and_meat_weight = case_when(
    notes %in% c("DEAD", "Dead when shucked", "dead") ~ NA, 
    TRUE ~ shell_weight_and_meat_weight
  )) %>%
  mutate(meat_weight = case_when(
    notes %in% c("DEAD", "Dead when shucked", "dead") ~ NA, 
    TRUE ~ meat_weight
  ))
```

```{r}
examine<-data %>%
  filter(grepl("DIED DURING PROCESSING|DYING|HOLE|KILLED|died|dying", notes))
```

```{r}
examine<-data %>%
  filter(grepl("DIED DURING PROCESSING|DYING", notes))

test <-test %>%
  mutate(total_weight = case_when(
    grepl("DIED DURING PROCESSING|DYING|DIED WHILE PROCESSSING", notes) ~ NA, 
    TRUE ~ total_weight
  ))
```

```{r}
examine<-data %>%
  filter(grepl("HOLE|KILLED|died|dying", notes))
```

leaking, maybe dying  get rid of total weight
KILLED DURING PROCESSING get rid of total weight
died while processing get rid of total weight
HOLE IN SHELL BEFORE SHUCK get rid of total weight

```{r}
test <- test %>%
  mutate(total_weight = case_when(
    grepl("HOLE|KILLED|died", notes) ~ NA, 
    TRUE ~ total_weight
  ))
```

```{r}
check <- test %>%
  filter(grepl("DEAD|Dead|dead|DIED|DYING|HOLE|KILLED|died", notes)) %>%
  select(total_weight, shell_weight_and_meat_weight, meat_weight)
```

Ok, these seems good 

```{r}
data %>%
  count(notes) %>% 
  print(n = Inf)
```

```{r}
data %>%
  filter(grepl("calipers",notes)) %>%
  select(shell_height,notes)
```

Ok, this is fine.

```{r}
data %>% filter(grepl("meat wieght", notes)) %>%
  select(meat_weight, notes)
```

```{r}
test <- data %>%
  mutate(meat_weight = case_when(
    grepl("meat wieght", notes) ~ 5.45,
    is.na(meat_weight) ~ NA, 
    TRUE ~ meat_weight
  )) %>%
  mutate(wt_adj_fec = case_when(
    grepl("meat wieght", notes) ~ egg_count/meat_weight, 
    TRUE ~ wt_adj_fec
  ))
```

Ok, looks like we are done with the notes. Thank god

```{r}

```

Let's look for obvious errors

```{r}
library(GGally)

data %>%
  select(total_weight,meat_weight) %>%
  ggpairs()
```

```{r}
data %>%
  filter(total_weight < 200 & meat_weight > 50) %>%
  select(total_weight, shell_length, shell_weight_and_meat_weight,meat_weight, shell_weight, tube_id)
```

Hmmm.. did shell weight and meat weight get mixed up?

```{r}
data %>% 
  filter(shell_length > 80 & shell_length < 96) %>%
  summarize(mean_meat = mean(meat_weight, na.rm = TRUE))

data %>% 
  filter(total_weight > 67 & total_weight < 87) %>%
  summarize(mean_meat = mean(meat_weight, na.rm = TRUE))
```

Yeah, I think the meat weight and shell weight got mixed up here

```{r}
test <- data %>%
  mutate(meat_weight = case_when(
    tube_id == "SEP_UVB_3" ~ 5.04, 
    TRUE ~ meat_weight

  mutate(shell_weight = case_when(
    tube_id == "SEP_UVB_3" ~ 59.2,
    TRUE ~ shell_weight
  ))
```

```{r}

  select(total_weight,meat_weight) %>%
  ggpairs()
```

The rest of these look fine.
